name: Retiro de Brasília (Fazenda Retiro Lótus do Cerrado)

location.address: Rodovia GO-118, km 31, Planaltina de Goiás, GO, Brazil

tradition: Kriya Yoga and meditation in the Paramahansa Yogananda / Self-Realization Fellowship lineage
technique: Kriya Yoga meditation, energization exercises, silent sitting meditation, devotional chanting (kirtan), and readings from Yogananda's teachings
teacherAccess: Sessions led by trained lay meditation teachers from the local Yogananda meditation group (Grupo de Brasília); no resident monastics.
retreatOptions: Residential silent meditation retreats of 3-6 nights held several times a year on a published calendar (e.g., a recurring Carnaval retreat), with lodging in shared suites or private chalets.
about: Retiro de Brasília, also known as Fazenda Retiro Lótus do Cerrado, is an independent meditation retreat in the Paramahansa Yogananda/Self-Realization Fellowship tradition, run by the local Yogananda meditation group (Grupo de Brasília) and listed on SRF's own site as an informal retreat location. It opened in February 2010 on a rural property off the GO-118 highway in Planaltina de Goiás, about 95 km from central Brasília, with accommodation in suites and private chalets. Several times a year — including a recurring Carnaval retreat and other holiday-timed programs — it hosts residential silent retreats of three to six nights built around Kriya Yoga and Yogananda-style meditation, group silence, devotional chanting, and readings from Yogananda's writings; no prior SRF/Yogananda affiliation is required to attend. Meals are ovo-lacto-vegetarian and included in the retreat fee, and sessions are led by trained lay meditation teachers rather than resident monastics.
schedule: Several residential retreats scheduled per year on a published calendar (the 2026 calendar includes a Carnaval retreat, 13-17 February), typically 3-6 nights each.
cost: Fixed per-person package fee covering full board (suite or chalet) and ovo-lacto-vegetarian meals; current rates are not published on the public site.
foodNotes: Ovo-lacto-vegetarian meals included in the retreat package.
